fact: The Ghana Statistical Service's own page reproduces the operative text of the Statistical Service Act (Act 1003) as the governing law; the page is undated, so the year is the Act's, 2019.
Ghana Statistical Service announced a stakeholder engagement with MDAs, development partners, civil society and academia on a proposed Statistics Ghana Bill, 2026.
This is the text of the Statistical Service Act, 2019 (Act 1003), assented to 24 September 2019 and commenced 27 September 2019.
